text: I built an open-source Discord moderation tool. On 200 manually reviewed messages it missed 6 cases. The code and evaluation script are available. Here are the limits: text only, no image inspection.
My prototype costs about $0.30 a month at 1,000 short messages a day in this test configuration. It uses Jev for classifications, not full conversations. Token size matters. Code is open source.

I tested a new code review tool on 40 pull requests. It missed three dependency problems and flagged two safe refactors. My sample is too small for a broad accuracy claim.
Has anyone reproduced a stale MutationObserver callback after a feed reuses an article node? My callback uses the previous post hash. I can reproduce it after navigating back.
